purpose: Authorized comparative outcome qualification; preserve all historical results. No historically untouched/independent replication claim.

recipe.training_objective: Retain original substantive multi-question targets and add one original single-choice question per video. Equal per-row weighting is a shared recipe change; retain original isolation results.

baseline_selection: Torch fused FP32 AdamW with full native activation checkpointing.12-layer and15-layer checkpoint subsets, micro2/acc2 andmicro1/acc4 without checkpointing all OOM; retain these failures. Nonpaged8-bit uses no recomputation. No paged speed claim.
target_definition: Unchanged0.95×initial fused validation NLL criterion, applied to audited gold-answer task NLL. Numeric target fixed from development32 rows before final scoring. Original substantive-task40-update results retained separately.

evaluation.historical_exposure: All32 eligible recording families outside repaired training/development were used in earlier final selections. Retain all32 prior questions and report both historical16-row subsets. Extra questions were chosen by metadata hash before new scores; they do not create unexposed recording families.

calibration.delivery_reserve_rule: ceil to5seconds of1.10×(maximum observed arm checkpoint time + maximum observed arm32-row scoring time +32seconds for96 additional forwards/source verification). Same rule for both arms; measured actual costs and overruns remain reportable.
calibration.product_budget_basis: 390seconds accommodates initialization plus useful adaptation and the expanded final scoring. Development32-row quantized330s canary delivered at329.64s; it is not reused as a final estimate. Matched15 is selected from best development NLL, not longer startup amortization.
calibration.training_budget_basis: 60s/10s reserve canary produced actual fused10 andquantized12 checkpoints. Final eligibility additionally requires completion of required validation within60s. No interpolation or later-state substitution.

clock_contract.training: Native loop entry through completed update/validation boundary; checkpoint and held-out scoring outside this clock but measured separately. A validation overrun censors the budget comparison.
clock_contract.prepared_product: Batch-shell/container/source setup, device preflight and prepared-corpus staging charged to each delivered run, then model verification, initialization, native train/development validation, full consistent checkpoint, checkpoint identity validation, fresh-process128-row scoring. Scheduler queue time excluded.
clock_contract.cold_product: Composed CPU input preparation followed by the prepared product clock. Same qualified measured CPU preparation cost C added to both arms; equal cold budget is C+390. No inference from a development curve.
clock_contract.cold_preparation_cost_rule: Use completed full_one SlurmElapsedRaw (including CPU container/setup) only after receipt proves all751logical rows/562unique targets, independent native replay, exact qualified-reference equality and no CUDA. If incomplete, cold comparisons remain censored; no substitution chosen from final results.
clock_contract.cold_limitation: One full CPU preparation measurement; repeated GPU product timings are conditional on that shared cost. No empty-OS-cache or independent full cold-pipeline replication claim. Three full CPU preparations did not fit observed costs within the unchanged7200s cap.

checkpoint_policy: Native full consolidated checkpoint at actual stop or natural15-update limit; keep_optim_last=0. Validate committed trainer clock against recorded completed updates and immutable checkpoint provenance. Score that committed model in a fresh process. Target stop requires observed post-update validation. Missing/late states are censored, never replaced by another state.

statistical_procedure.timing_seed_aggregation: Mean of3 paired restart ratios within each seed, then95% Student t interval across3seed means. Timing restarts are not extra quality seeds.
statistical_procedure.quality: 95% Student t across3paired seed NLL ratios/accuracy differences. Also10000 crossed seed/recording-family bootstrap draws, RNGseed2026; average4questions within each family before resampling32families. Both NLL/accuracy guard intervals must pass.
statistical_procedure.equal_budget_gain: Positive lower95% bound on baseline-minus8bit held-out gold-answer NLL in both paired-seed and recording bootstrap analyses, with accuracy guard. Any ineligible arm censors the paired estimate.
statistical_procedure.adaptation: Positive recording-bootstrap lower bound on task accuracy relative to the frozen model, reported separately for both trained arms.
statistical_procedure.multiplicity: All requested gates are conjunctive; no cherry-picking passing endpoint, seed or historical subset. No tuning from these final scores.

gates.time_to_quality_target: 0.95 times paired fused initial validation NLL; unchanged prior criterion

resources.hardware: A100-SXM4-80GB,8CPUs,128GiB requested host memory per GPU allocation; paired arms/restarts share one allocation/device/affinity. At most two seed allocations, on distinct nodes; third depends on first completion.
resources.cost_estimate: 12training/scoring cases per seed: approximately180–214s train/export plus~120s scoring; up to4010s at upper calibration plus shared setup/exposure/frozen reference. Reserve4500s to avoid undersized allocations; all failures count.

source_policy: One immutable runtime archive across all final seeds and all arms. Record archiveSHA256, native tree provenance, model shard hashes, dependency versions, prepared corpus identity, actual sequence/media/token exposure, device and host memory. No push/publication.
failure_policy: Keep failed/censored comparisons and inspect actionable defects. Any new tuning uses training/development only and needs a new locked comparison; do not repeatedly consume final groups for tuning. Never relax thresholds. Preserve budget headroom and all failed allocation costs.
